Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 20-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Computer Vision [ECE_4410]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Given a digital video of 10 seconds with frame rate of 60 frames per second, each frame being 512 (5)  
  x 512 x 3 color image, each pixel is represented by 8 bits of resolution. Compute the time required  
  A)           to transmit the video over a channel with transmission rate of 2.097 Mbps, assuming no data  
  compression and ideal conditions.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Explain in brief on aspect ratio with respect to any display device. Bring out the rational why any    (5)  
  display device does not have same dimension for height and width?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Explain Laplacian of a digital image. Derive the elements of a 3 × 3 Laplacian mask using basic        (5)  
  principles.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Describe the concept of weighted average filter applied in digital image processing with the           (5)  
  necessary equations and interpretation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                Illustrate the concept of image segmentation. Explain in detail on any two, 3 × 3 masks that can be    (5)  
  used in segmenting digital images?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Demonstrate on how gradient operators can be used in image segmentation. Deduce the mask for           (5)  
  gradient operation using fundamental principles?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Illustrate the concept of class conditional probability density function. Explain how univariate       (5)  
  Gaussian data can be modeled using class conditional probability density function.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyse the concept of class histogram used in Bayesian learning.                                      (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  Page #1

5)                        Develop the multilayer perceptron architecture with computational steps?                            (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Explain the 2 category SVM model used in pattern classification, with necessary computational       (5)  
  expressions.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
